I recently built a near‑identical solution for PayLedger, where I combined Tesseract OCR with image deskewing and spaCy entity extraction to pull vendor, totals, dates and tax IDs from scanned invoices. The pipeline achieved 96% field‑level accuracy on a held‑out set of 500 invoices and cut manual entry time by 70% [E1], and the codebase includes the same deskewing and Python‑based REST API you’ll need [E2].

The riskiest part is the variability in camera image quality; inconsistent lighting or angle can degrade OCR performance, so the first step should be a quick audit of a sample batch to define preprocessing parameters and set measurable quality thresholds.
